title: When the Orbit Sings
author: Rosalind Galloway
blurb: Emrys Crane, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
